meta.name: get-qodo-rules
meta.description: Loads org- and repo-level coding rules from Qodo before code tasks begin, ensuring all generation and modification follows team standards. Use before any code generation or modification task when rules are not already loaded. Invoke when user asks to write, edit, refactor, or review code, or when starting implementation planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 加载团队编码规则，确保代码符合规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队有编码规则需要自动遵守
copy.tagline_en: Load team coding rules to ensure code compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team has coding rules to enforce automatically

howto.what: 在代码任务开始前,技能会从 Qodo 平台获取组织和仓库级的编码规则,按 ERROR、WARNING、RECOMMENDATION 分组显示,并在生成或修改代码时应用这些规则;ERROR 规则必须遵守并添加注释,完成后还会报告规则的执行情况。
howto.when: 当用户要求写、编辑、重构等代码任务,开始实施规划,或明确要求加载 Qodo 规则,且规则尚未加载时触发。

say.text: 先加载 Qodo 规则,再开始写登录功能。
say.note: Claude 会先获取并显示规则。

say.text: 重构用户模块前,先获取仓库编码规则。
say.note: 重构前会拉取规则并应用。

say.text: 开始实施计划前,加载 Qodo 规则。
say.note: 实现规划前会加载规则。

howto.what_en: Loads org and repo coding rules from Qodo before code tasks, shows them by severity, enforces them while coding (ERROR must add comment), and reports after.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to write, edit, refactor, or review code, starts implementation planning, or explicitly requests loading Qodo rules, and rules are not already loaded.

say_en.text: Load Qodo rules first, then write the login feature.
say_en.note: Claude fetches and shows rules first.

say_en.text: Fetch the repo rules before refactoring the user module.
say_en.note: Loads rules and applies them to the refactor.

say_en.text: Load Qodo rules before starting the implementation plan.
say_en.note: Rules are loaded before planning starts.
